title: TypeID 104 C_TS_NA_1 safe single-object analogue
purpose: Stay close to the documented GHSA parser path by using a valid CS104 I-frame for TypeID 104 with VSQ count 1 and a complete object body.
expected_behavior: An implementation should parse a well-formed TypeID 104 test command APDU with one object and a complete body, reaching the same general parser family implicated by the issue without overrunning memory.
constraints_preserved: Start byte 0x68 and explicit APDU length 0x0e are correct
Four APCI control bytes precede the ASDU
VSQ is one-object non-sequence form, not oversized
ASDU includes 2-octet CoT, 2-octet CA, and 3-octet IOA
A trailing one-byte test-command payload is present to keep the object complete
issue_safety_notes: This is not the published GHSA payload and specifically avoids the dangerous oversized VSQ/body mismatch.
